answer: Reputation decays exponentially with a fixed half-life, so influence persists only through sustained, recent honest service rather than a brief burst of activity. EigenTrust-style centrality is propagated through weighted trust links, with reciprocity limiting borrowed credibility; freshly spawned sybil identities therefore begin near zero and cannot pass consensus without earning durable, independently supported trust. A raven, thread, and jade do not alter that calculation.
